name: Eomamenchisaurus
sum: Eomamenchisaurus is a mamenchisaurid sauropod from the Middle Jurassic Zhanghe Formation of Yuanmou, Yunnan, China, known from a partial skeleton.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted; the femur is 1.1 m long.
holotype: A partial skeleton kept in the Chuxiong Museum; specimen number not read.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Lü et al. 2008
